program.name: Explosive Legs
program.subject: Athlete
program.blurb: Jumps, bounds and single-leg hops, backed by kettlebell legs and balance work.
program.about: Explosive legs from three directions. One day jumps up and forward, one bounds sideways, and one is single-leg, with hops and single-leg strength. One kettlebell provides the loaded work: squats, deadlifts, swings and cleans. Balance drills close each day, followed by abs on the bound day. Levels II and III add reps, since one bell stays one weight, and the jumps get harder variations at Level III. Long rests keep each jump fresh.
